newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson in Singapore research agreement.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson in Singapore research agreement.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group AB LM Ericsson said on Friday it signed a joint research agreement with two Singapore institutes to study high-speed wireless data communications.
The project, called Wireless ATM, will investigate systems and build a test bed in the five GHz band with data transmitted at 25 MHz, the company said in a statement.
The two research centres, the Institute of Systems Science and the Centre for Wireless Communications, are affiliated with the National University of Singapore, Ericsson said.
New applications, such as portable multimedia terminals for tourists, could emerge from the project, Ericsson said.
Offices could also be reorganised without expensive rewiring for computer terminals, it said. Busy areas such as hospitals and airports could have data transmitted to workers on the move.
Wireless ATM is the second joint research venture between Ericsson and the two Singapore institutes.
